name: Disable Windows Search Indexing
description: Disables the Windows Search indexing service to reduce background activity and disk usage, though search results may take longer to appear.

description_i18n.en: Disables the Windows Search indexing service to reduce background activity and disk usage, though search results may take longer to appear.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Windows-Suchindexierungsdienst, um Hintergrundaktivität und Festplattennutzung zu reduzieren; Suchergebnisse können länger daürn.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le service d'indexation de recherche Windows pour réduire l'activité en arrière-plan et l'utilisation du disque ; les résultats peuvent prendre plus de temps.

warnings.title: Slower Search Results
warnings.message: Windows will not index new or changed files automatically, so search results may take longer to appear after adding content

warnings.title: Service state change
warnings.message: Related Windows services may stop or restart briefly while the action runs

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Disables the WSearch service startup type and stops it if running This prevents background indexing of files on your system
